title: The Value of Descriptive Analytics: Evidence from Online Retailers
eligible_reason: The underlying adoption design is staggered and binary (retailer-channels adopt analytics in 18 monthly cohorts, Jan 2016-Jun 2017, with later adopters as never-treated controls), but no reported specification satisfies the rules. The only staggered-DiD code in the package (SDiD.do, Equations 2 and 3, Table 5 columns 1-2 and Figure 2) is a Wooldridge (2021) extended-TWFE regression with cohort dummies, cohort x post-month interactions and cohort-specific linear time trends (c.cohortK#c.month_id), absorbing month FE only (cohort FE instead of unit FE). Cohort-specific trends fall under the excluded 'unit/group-specific trends'. Table 5 columns 3-4 and Figure 3 are synthetic DiD (excluded). In addition the package data is a disguised 5% random sample, so published estimates cannot be reproduced.
design_notes: Files: README.txt, SDiD.do (Stata, reghdfe), SynthDiD.R + SynthDiD-fun.R (R, custom synthetic-DiD functions), data_file_for_replication_small.csv (2,090 retailer-channel x month rows, 107 retailer-channels, months 1-24 = 7/2015-6/2017). Variables: company_id, company_source (unit), month_id, m_after (post-adoption indicator), month_join_id (adoption month; >24 = not treated in window -> cohort 999), join_lag, m_log_rev_usd (log avg weekly revenue). Eq (3): pre-trend test on m_after==0 sample with cohort dummies, cohort trends and lag dummies. Eq (2): cohort1-18 + cohortK#monthM for M>=adoption month + cohortK#c.month_id trends, absorb(month_id), vce(cluster company_id month_id); ATT for 3 and 6 months via lincom averages (Table 5 cols 1-2). README says the paper's main results in the SDiD section are these; other sections of the paper are not covered by the package.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Code defines 18 monthly cohorts (month_id 7-24 = Jan 2016-Jun 2017); the 5% sample contains 12 of them plus later adopters (month_join_id 25-40) treated as controls.

specs.exclusion_reason: cohort-specific linear time trends (c.cohortK#c.month_id) and cohort-by-period saturated interactions; no unit FE (cohort dummies + month FE); ATT formed by lincom averaging
specs.treatment_var: cohortK#monthM interactions (K=1..18 cohorts, M>=adoption month); m_after is the underlying post indicator
specs.treatment_definition: adoption of descriptive analytics dashboard in month month_join_id; cohort 999 (= never treated in window) for month_join_id>24
specs.fe: absorb(month_id); cohort dummies cohort1-cohort18; cohort trends
specs.static_or_event: static ATT (3- and 6-month averages via lincom)
specs.reported_location: Table 5 columns 1-2; Figure 2 uses the same coefficients

specs.notes: custom estNplot() in SynthDiD-fun.R, lags=6, leads=5, cohorts 7:18

data_access: proprietary (package has a disguised random 5% sample of retailer-channels)
data_files: data and replication files/data_file_for_replication_small.csv (57 KB, 5% disguised sample)
screener_notes: Full text not available; the paper may contain additional TWFE/event-study specifications outside the SDiD section (flags include Callaway, Borusyak, de Chaisemartin, Goodman-Bacon mentions), but the README states the package covers the main SDiD-section results only, and the data provided cannot reproduce any published number. Re-screen if article text becomes available.
